description: List Streaming Radar newsletter articles with optional filters. Returns id, number, title, subtitle, status, type, published_at, substack_url and editorial_angle; views and open_rate only with an admin key. Without an admin key only published articles are returned and any other status filter is rejected. Free access — no API key required.

status.description: Filter by status: published, draft, archived. Non-admin keys may only request published.

type.description: Filter by content type: edition, analysis, special

name: sr_get_articles

outputSchema.description: Tool-specific result object. Inspect the `content` array for human-readable text and structured data.
